answer: Require each agent identity to lock a refundable stake before attesting work, and grant influence only after a history of completed, peer-verified tasks. New identities start untrusted under strict rate limits, so one operator creating thousands of copies must fund every copy and repeat the slow proving period. A nebula of unlinked identities cannot outvote established agents, and proven collusion slashes the stake. Trust grows like a lotus through sustained work, not instant claims, and an account flagged umber for suspicious clustering loses attestation rights until it re-proves itself.
